title: Made a free browser tool that turns 3D models into sprite sheets, figured this sub might get some use out of it
author: OmniSpriteOfficial
selftext:
I kept generating 3D characters and then getting stuck turning them into sprites for a 2D game, so I built a tool for it: [https://omnisprite.com](https://omnisprite.com)



Drop in a rigged GLB, pick your angles (up to 16 directions), size, fps and look (pixel art, outlines, palette limits, that kind of thing), and it bakes a sprite sheet for each animation. Since every frame comes from the same model, the sprites stays consistent, which I've been struggling with straight 2D generation.

It's free with no sign-up, and everything runs in your browser, so your models never get uploaded anywhere. Whatever you make from it is yours. The robot in the gif is from the built-in library if you just want to mess around.

Made this with Claude over the last few weeks and thought I'd share it with other gamedevs who might find it useful

Would love to hear what breaks, especially with GLBs from whatever image-to-3D tools you're using.

  
P.S. I confirmed with mods to post this since it is a promotion but the site is not monetized at all and I have no plans to ever make this a paid product or service and they said it shouldn't be an issue since I just want to release it for the community as a free tool.  
  
Would love feedback on what to add or fix to make it more useful.
